title: A mild and efficient synthesis of N-aryl glycines by the rearrangement of 2-chloro-N-aryl acetamides
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21061-21067
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02497H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vamshikrishna Y. Radhakrishna, Khajamohiddin Syed, Vipin A. Nair
An intermolecular cyclization of 2-chloro-N-aryl acetamides followed by ring opening of the intermediate 1,4-diarylpiperazine-2,5-diones afforded N-aryl glycines in an efficient, one-pot sequential addition process.
